name: Background jobs
summary: A team digest sent by background jobs on Inngest: a React page, a Hono API on Postgres, and a worker whose cron, fan-out, retries and onFailure send through Resend and bill through Stripe.
runsOn: A Vite page, a Hono API and an Inngest worker in Chromium, with the Inngest dev server and Postgres in Docker
shows: Background jobs on the real Inngest dev server: `settle()` waits for every run, its fan-out, retries and `onFailure` handler included
`time.travel` to a digest's send time runs the hourly cron, which fans out one `digest/send-one` per subscriber in batches
Invariants that read Postgres against Resend and Stripe: one email per subscriber per digest, one invoice item per batch, and every failed copy told to its owner
`danwo matrix` faulting the event sends, Resend, Stripe and the jobs' own SQL (58 trials), and `JOBS_BUG` switches that turn off the idempotency keys or the steps
